theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_odc_rc_ray_cutoff
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (F : Finset (Euclid P)), (∀ e ∈ F, ‖e‖ = 1) → ∀ e₀ : Euclid P, ‖e₀‖ = 1 → ∀ ψ : ℝ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → tsupport ψ ⊆ Ioi 0 → ∃ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f ∧ HasCompactSupport f ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, f (s • e₀) = ψ s) ∧ ∀ e ∈ F, e ≠ e₀ → ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → f (t • e) = 0
